ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with localized high-intensity clusters; estimated ratio of 9:1 dark-to-light pixels on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey/black region across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white/yellowish-white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; sparse white punctate spots are visible in the central-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 42-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge; high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations in the medial sections transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular protrusions at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally linear to slightly concave sweep from the median notch to the tips, significantly modulated by marginal serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured clusters of high-contrast white/yellow pixel groups located at the terminal ends of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural deformation of the lobe tips due to heavy barnacle encrustation, particularly prominent on the left lobe extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel cluster with motion blur at the base of the fluke, representing splashing water occluding the peduncle junction.
